## 12. Change of control

Either party may terminate this agreement immediately upon written notice if the other party undergoes a change of control.

This agreement does not require consent or notice as a condition of assignment, except that assignment to a direct competitor is prohibited.

## 19. Governing law

Northbridge: sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics". Billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc." A 2024 credit check also returned a Wyoming LLC, "Northbridge Analytics LLC". Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party. Treat that registry link as unresolved.
